build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with potentials and transitions graphs using gen_model
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a CRF with gen_transitions given num_classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph for a CRF with gen_potentials given num_features and num_classes
sample_crf_data: sample training data from a CRF model using sample_model with potentials and transitions graphs
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF loss for a sequence pair using crf_loss with potentials and transitions
